publications.title: The LEGO Group teams up with Sesame Street to inspire young children to fall in love with nature
publications.summary: Responsibility October 27, 2026 The LEGO Group teams up with Sesame Street to inspire young children to fall in love with nature The LEGO Group and Sesame Workshop, the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street, have launched three new videos, funded by the LEGO Foundation, encouraging children aged 4 to 6 to discover the natural world through play. Featuring Elmo, Cookie Monster and other Sesame Street friends, the videos introduce children to bats, butterflies and worms before inviting them to build habitats using LEGO bricks and everyday craft materials. The LEGO Group’s free activity guides and printables help families and educators extend the experience through hands-on play at home and in community settings.

publications.title: Ciao, Venice: The LEGO Group floats new Icons set
publications.summary: Products October 15, 2026 Ciao, Venice: The LEGO Group floats new Icons set The LEGO Group reveals the LEGO® Icons Venetian Neighbourhood (11388) set. With 5,682 pieces, this is one of the most intricate city dioramas in the LEGO Icons collection and marks the first time the LEGO Group has created a cityscape-style display model of this scale, inviting builders to capture the romance, rhythm and remarkable architecture of Venice with LEGO elements – no passport required.

publications.title: Review: 11388 Venetian Neighbourhood
publications.summary: 11388 Venetian Neighbourhood is this year's 'mega set' that's being released in time for the holiday season. It's stylistically similar to last year's Ideas model 21359 Italian Riviera, but much larger. It's also the second retail set to contain a 3D-printed element, a 'functional' piano, the first being last year's Winter Village set . The model is billed as being for 'travel lovers' and is 'inspired by the canals and architecture of the legendary city'. However, I suspect that anyone who's actually been there would have had the same thought as me when I first saw it: 'I don't remember seeing a tower like that in Venice'... Continue reading » © 2026 Brickset.com . Republication prohibited without prior permission.

publications.title: Review: 40889 Build, Paint and Play!
publications.summary: Build, Paint and Play! by Doomslizer was picked as the winner of LEGO Ideas' Build Your Hobby challenge in September 2025. One year later, the revised model is about to be released and I think it looks superb, taking a fresh approach to model kit assembly! Beyond a clever concept, 40889 Build, Paint and Play! includes a few elements of great interest to Classic Space fans. While the teal astronaut has appeared before, the light bluish grey helmet and air tanks are new, completing a minifigure began in 2017, so I expect this to be a popular gift-with-purchase. publications.title: LEGO DAFT PUNK confirmed for 2027!
publications.summary: Following a teaser yesterday, a partnership has today been announced between the LEGO Group and DAFT PUNK, to include an upcoming Ideas set! The press release follows: Builders After All: The LEGO Group and DAFT PUNK announce partnership – blending worlds of music, culture and creative experimentation Today, the LEGO Group and DAFT PUNK are proud to announce a new partnership that aims to inspire and remix fandoms, with the Daft Punk robots entering the LEGO universe. publications.title: Review: 30762 Retro Video Game Batman
publications.summary: Batman has worn countless unique suits across his many appearances and despite the range of Batman minifigures available, lots of memorable bat-suits have not appeared in LEGO form.
